defects.description: Documentation says the limit is per API key; the implementation actually keys by IP address -- behaviorally different (shared-IP clients like an office NAT share one bucket across many API keys).
Documentation promises a Retry-After header on 429 responses; the implementation never sets one.
Nothing tests the documented contract against the implementation, so doc and code can silently diverge again -- this is the systemic gap behind both individual mismatches.
